answer: Proposal: close the identity mint. The chain counts live seats and refuses registrations beyond a fixed cap S; reward nectar reaches only registered seats, so a plume of fresh signups earns nothing — pure arithmetic, no issuer to trust. Holders exit by surrendering a seat to the protocol at a floor price F, and surrendered seats re-auction: a buyer's price is a mirror of honest newcomers' bids, near a seat's discounted earnings. N seats cost an attacker at least N×F — honestly linear, no cheap mint; wealth can still concentrate. Assumption: the floor fund, fed by fees, stays solvent.
